x-e-e2-08.title: Wara na kiri sara phrase so alingbi pëpe na histoire ti Coco
x-e-e2-08.goal: Na yâ ti phrases ôko, wara oko so akpe preuve ti kozo na ti pekoni, na kiri gbâ ni tongana phrase so alingbi na histoire.
x-e-e2-08.material: Na ando ayeke texte kete so afa chien ti ndo ti zo, Coco. Phrase oko alingbi pëpe na phrases ti ambeni na texte.
x-e-e2-08.thinking.0: Ti mû pene pene phrases ti wara contradiction
x-e-e2-08.thinking.1: Ti kpe na côté so ayeke na preuve mingi ahon
x-e-e2-08.prereq.0: Adjectifs ti nzoni tongana big, small, brown, white
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.prompt: Yôro phrase so alingbi pëpe na phrases ti ambeni na texte.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kamata na ndö oko lignes so afa lege ti Coco na mû pene pene ala.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tongana lignes mingi akpe, kpe na côté so lignes mingi asûtenu ni.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.explain: Lignes 2 na 3 atene so Coco ayeke kete mingi. Ligne 4 atene so Coco ayeke kota na brown, ni la ni akpe na lignes use so. Lignes 1 na 5 alingbi na histoire ti Coco.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.prompt: Gbâ phrase so kiri na anglais si ni alingbi na histoire ti Coco.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bâ fait oko ti Coco so a tene ni pëpe kozo.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.hint.1: Gbâ phrase kete so akamata na She wala Coco.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mo vérifier so phrase vandâ akpe phrases ti kozo pëpe?
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ni ayeke na information vandâ ti Coco?
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ni amû information vandâ ti Coco.

x-e-e2-09.title: Sara phrase so alingbi pëpe na texte ti fruit na mû ni na ami tongana devinette
x-e-e2-09.goal: Hinga so phrase so alingbi pëpe ayeke na ndö ti sujet, na sara sujet oko na phrase oko so alingbi na ni pëpe.
x-e-e2-09.material:
Mo yeke ti sara devinette 'odd one out' ti mû na ami. Kozo e bâ exemple oko.

I like apples. I like bananas. Grapes are sweet. ?
x-e-e2-09.thinking.0: Ti yôro phrases na ndö ti sujet
x-e-e2-09.thinking.1: Ti sara phrase so alingbi pëpe
x-e-e2-09.thinking.2: Ti fa réponse ti devinette so mo sara ni
x-e-e2-09.prereq.0: Phrases ti nzoni tongana I like ~. na ~ is/are ...
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.prompt: Phrase wa alingbi pëpe tongana phrase ti osio? (Sujet: fruit)
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Tene sujet même ti phrases ota ti kozo na mot oko.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Vérifier so phrase oko ayeke na sujet so pëpe.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.a: Pêche ayeke fruit, ni la ni alingbi na sujet.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.b: Orange ayeke fruit nga, ni la ni alingbi.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.c: Carotte ayeke fruit pëpe. Tongana a bâ sujet tongana 'fruit', ni alingbi pëpe.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.explain: Phrases ota ti kozo kue ayeke ti fruits (pommes, bananes, raisins). Carotte ayeke légume, ni la ni alingbi na sujet pëpe. Tongana mo kota sujet na 'nourriture', carotte alingbi nga. So ni alingbi wala pëpe ayeke na ndö ti sujet so mo zia décision.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.prompt: Sara devinette ti mû na ami. (1) Phrases anglaises ota so alingbi na sujet oko, (2) phrase oko so alingbi pëpe (ti osio), (3) gbâ réponse na nzoroko, tongana "Odd one: 4."
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Yôro sujet oko (animaux, école, nourriture, na ambeni) na kozo gbâ phrases ota ti sujet so.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Gbâ phrase ti sujet ndulu tongana phrase ti osio, na sara addition ti 'Odd one: 4.'
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Sujet ti phrases ota ti kozo ayeke clair oko gï?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Phrase ti osio ayeke na sujet ndulu me ayeke gbâ na forme?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Tongana ami ti mo asara ni, indice wa lo sara na ni ti wara réponse?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.0: Tënë ti nourriture amélanger na histoire ti chat.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Phrase ti tigre amélanger na histoire ti école.

x-e-e2-10.title: Sara question oko so awara information so angbâ pëpe na message texte
x-e-e2-10.topic: Ti hunda question oko so ayeke ye
x-e-e2-10.goal: Wara information so ayeke na message pëpe, yôro question oko so ayeke ye mingi ahon, na sara question ti mo même na situation vandâ.
x-e-e2-10.material:
Ami ti mo Sora atene message texte.

"Let's play tomorrow! Bring a ball."

Mo aye ti gue, me ye kete ayeke so mo lingbi ti hinga pëpe.
x-e-e2-10.thinking.0: Ti wara information so angbâ pëpe
x-e-e2-10.thinking.1: Ti mû pene pene ti kota ti questions so ayeke ye
x-e-e2-10.thinking.2: Ti wara information so mo a besoin ni na question oko
x-e-e2-10.prereq.0: Mots ti question tongana When, Where, What time
x-e-e2-10.prereq.1: Ti gbâ ? na nzoroko ti question
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.prompt: Yôro question oko so ayeke ye mingi ahon ti hunda Sora.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Divisé message na colonnes use: ye so ni atene awe na ye so mo hinga pëpe angbâ.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bâ ye so a besoin ti hinga ti kpe.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.a: Question so ahunda information use na lâ oko: ndo na ngoi, use kue ayeke ye ti kpe.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.b: Message atene awe ti ga na balle. Sorte ti balle alingbi ti ayeke nzoni ti hinga, me ni amû information ti ambeni so a besoin ni pëpe.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.c: Mo lingbi ti hinga ndo, me mo hinga ngoi pëpe angbâ. Gï ye oko a zia décision ti ni.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.d: So Sora aye balles ayeke information so a besoin ni ti kpe pëpe.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.explain: Message ayeke na gï "tomorrow" na "bring a ball," na ndo na ngoi ayeke pëpe. Question so ahunda information use na lâ oko ayeke ye mingi ahon. Question so ahunda gï ndo asara si ngoi angbâ ti hinga pëpe, na questions ti sorte ti balle wala ti goûts ti Sora ayeke information so a besoin ni ti kpe pëpe.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.prompt: Ni ayeke situation vandâ. Papa atene: "We'll go on a trip on Saturday." Gbâ question oko anglaise ti wara information so ayeke ye mingi ahon so angbâ pëpe. (Sara na point d'interrogation oko gï)
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Fa ndulu ti ye so mo hinga awe na tënë ti Papa (Saturday, trip) na ye so mo hinga pëpe.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Yôro oko ti ye so mo hinga pëpe na sara question so akamata na Where wala What time.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Question ti mbi ahunda information so ayeke na tënë ti Papa pëpe?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Réponse ti question so alingbi ti mû aide ti ti zia ye ti voyage?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ti hunda ti ngoi ayeke nzoni nga.
